name: The Women's Scrub Set
headline: Tailored V-Neck & High-Waist 7-Pocket Jogger Pant Set
description: Certified Australian hospital-grade nursing scrubs designed specifically for female nurses, doctors, surgeons, and healthcare clinicians. Pairs an architectural contoured V-neck with an ergonomic waistband and 7-pocket clinical storage. Crafted from our signature BeauTech™ 4-way stretch fabric with Silvadur™ antimicrobial silver technology. Soft matte finish, fluid barrier defense, anti-wrinkle resilience, and breathable moisture-wicking comfort tested across 14-hour hospital shifts.
details: Engineered with proprietary BeauTech™ 4-way recoil stretch fabric
Silvadur™ antimicrobial silver-ion defense against odor and hospital microbes
Certified Australian Medical Grade Standard (TGA guidelines compliant)
Technical Composition: 63% Recycled Poly, 34% Viscose, 3% Elastane
Architectural V-neck top with contour waist darting and badge clip loop
7 deep clinical pockets including shears loop and zippered phone pocket
High-rise yoga knit comfort waistband with flat contrast drawcord
Reinforced bar-tack stress points engineered for 14-hour clinical rounds
Tested for industrial 60°C hospital sanitisation laundry cycles
fabricCare: Machine wash cold inside-out (tested for 60°C hospital sanitisation cycles)
Tumble dry low or line dry in shade
fitNotes: Tailored Australian feminine fit. Soft matte finish with a structured silhouette. Model is 175cm / 5'9" and wears Australian Size AU 8 (S).
